args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1, the service failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production, and its release candidate v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. checkout-api was rolled back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, the service is healthy in all regions with an error rate of 0.2%. Next steps: find the root cause in v2.3.1 before redeploying, and check why it was promoted even though the RC was unhealthy in staging.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident, which paged on-call.

- **Before:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. The service was unhealthy, with an error rate of 18%.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to it. All three regions now run v2.3.0.
- **After:** The service is healthy, with an error rate of 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api). It describes the failure, the rollback and the current state. It also sets two next steps:
  - Find what's wrong in v2.3.1 before deploying it again.
  - Check why v2.3.1 reached production when its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had already failed health checks in staging.
